title: Summit Reinstatement Fee Bands
content:
The Crestline Summit Loyalty Program sets the band fee for reinstating expired miles by the miles of the forfeiture entry being reinstated, the forfeiture being the latest inactivity forfeiture entry on the membership. Band bounds are inclusive.

| Miles of the forfeiture entry | Band fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 30001 | 150 (the band fee is kept at the first band) |
| 30001 up to 75000 (75001 less one) | 250 |
| 75001 or more | 400 |

**Boundary readings (hypothetical forfeitures)**

| Miles forfeited | Band | Band fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 30000 | First | 150 |
| 30001 | Middle | 250 |
| 75000 | Middle | 250 |
| 75001 | Top | 400 |

The band turns only on the miles of the forfeiture entry; the member's tier, balance and history do not move it.
